# Character base provenance

- Author: Kay Lousberg (KayKit).
- Pack: KayKit Character Pack — Adventurers 1.0.
- Source: https://github.com/KayKit-Game-Assets/KayKit-Character-Pack-Adventures-1.0
- Source commit: `672074b73ba276876a19e8816ecdc5241817ab47`.
- License: CC0 1.0; the complete upstream notice is in [LICENSE.txt](LICENSE.txt).
- Unmodified source files: `Barbarian.glb`, `barbarian_texture.png`.

The derivative `assets/models/butter-base30.blend` / `.glb` reuses the base's
body, arm and leg topology and skin weights, with different proportions. The
head is reshaped and given closed convex retopology. Original beard, facial
details, gear, textures and animation clips are not used in the derivative.

New swept hair, floppy ears, outfit, pouch, tail and slingshot are native 3D
geometry. Facial artwork from `assets/butter-2d-study.png` is baked into the
head's UV atlas, not attached as image planes. The approved source picture is
unchanged. No hair or clothing surface uses that illustration as a texture.

This is an unofficial fan appearance/rig study of Butter from Trickcal, not
an official character model. CC0 covers the KayKit source; it does not grant
rights to the Trickcal character or artwork. New animation clips are not yet
included, and the game assets are not replaced by this study.
